committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 4 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last 7 days is up to A$153.47 from A$118.45 while clicks held flat at 17, pushing CPC to A$9.03; the A$600 test credit is now at A$0 remaining. Impression share sits at 10% with 75.8% lost to rank versus only 16.8% lost to budget, so rank is the limiter right now, not spend.

Since the landing page test started, raw ask_cta_click sits at 19 against zero review_cta_click (bookings) and 3 quick_question_click, out of 82 raw paid clicks logged. The page passed click 25 a while back so headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something is broken.

generate_lead fired once this week (Tue 3), with 1 form start recorded in the same period. This is an unverified enquiry candidate only, not demand, and needs grading against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) before it counts for anything.

Sessions fell to 48 from 53 (-9%) over the last 7 days, and yesterday (Tue 3) logged just 2 sessions against 9 on the same weekday last week (Tue 27). Direct dropped to 18 from 25 but that is mostly Chris and untracked referrers, not unpaid demand; Organic Search held steady at 8. AI Assistant sessions are at 0 this week (was 1), so no source to name, though this channel undercounts by nature. Search Console data runs through Sun 1, about two days behind yesterday.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the landing page test have reached 82, past the 75 mark: have Chris check the test log now, since 75-plus relevant clicks with zero qualified enquiries trips the red flag.

Credit remaining is now A$0. Apply the pause rule: continue paid search only if cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review, and review_cta_click is still 0, so this needs resolving before any further spend.
One generate_lead has fired since the last check: open the Formspree/Cal.com email, confirm its source, and grade it in the test log against the qualified rule.
Standing item: logo and image assets are still needed for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake).
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours saved per week and 99.6% success; these need updating to match current site stats.
